answer: Start with Proof of unique flash-loan repayment record. The idea is simple: loans repaid in the same block, dozens of times, and that lotus alone separates one real agent from a hundred fakes. One honest agent pays this cost once and is done. A farm pays it per clone, and the comet compounds: ten clones cost ten proofs, a hundred cost a hundred, and the payout per clone never grows. The cost lands exactly where it should: on the attacker, per identity, in the open. The oasis is public, auditable, and impossible to discount in bulk.
